item.title: MeTube vs Pinchflat vs TubeSync in 2026: Which Self-Hosted YouTube Archiver Actually Keeps Your Library?
item.description: A video you bookmarked in 2023 has a coin-flip chance of still being there in 2026. Channels get deleted, videos go private, region blocks appear overnight, and the “watch later” list is not an archive — it is a bookmark to someone else’s filesystem. If a tutorial, a conference talk, or a music set matters to you, the only durable copy is the one on your own disk.
